title: Duke's claim about writing 'Mood Indigo' at breakfast
summary: Bigard laughs at Duke's article saying he wrote 'Mood Indigo' in fifteen minutes while his mother made breakfast, when Bigard says he gave Duke the last half and Duke added the first.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x:
Yeah, at the last second. I mean, he was funny like that. I don't know why -- what caused him to do those kind of things.

And another thing he did -- I had to laugh when I read that article -- he said he wrote "Mood Indigo" at his

breakfast while his mother was making his breakfast. And he said just about -- he didn't have nothing to do and had to make a little thing for Barney to record, which I had given him the last half of the tune already and he just put -- added the first part. And he said he did that in 15 minutes.
MS. WILLARD: It made a good story. He was a master of dramatics.

MR. BIGARD: Oh, yeah. And I never had the chance to get to see him to give him hell about that, because I'd give him hell, you know. Anytime I'd see him and he did something I didn't like, I'd tell him.

Yeah, but he's quite a -- he was a fantastic man. I mean, believe me. Course, he did a lot of bad things which I didn't approve and a few other guys in the band didn't approve but nobody would say anything.
